{"id":1852729885,"question_id":3819,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"7 months, 1 week","timestamp":1765441813,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"379 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1852729885/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Count Covered Buildings","memory":"354.6 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int countCoveredBuildings(int n, vector<vector<int>>& buildings) {\n        unordered_map<int , int>maxi_x;\n        unordered_map<int , int>mini_x;\n        unordered_map<int , int>maxi_y;\n        unordered_map<int , int>mini_y;\n\n        for(auto &pt : buildings)\n        {\n            int x = pt[0];\n            int y = pt[1];\n\n            if(!mini_x.count(y)) mini_x[y] = x;\n            else \n                mini_x[y] = min(mini_x[y], x);\n\n            if(!maxi_x.count(y)) maxi_x[y] = x;\n            else \n                maxi_x[y] = max(maxi_x[y], x);\n\n            if(!mini_y.count(x)) mini_y[x] = y;\n            else \n                mini_y[x] = min(mini_y[x], y);\n\n            if(!maxi_y.count(x)) maxi_y[x] = y;\n            else \n                maxi_y[x] = max(maxi_y[x], y);\n        }\n\n        int covered_buildings = 0;\n        for(auto &it : buildings)\n        {\n            int x = it[0];\n            int y = it[1];\n\n            if(x > mini_x[y] && x < maxi_x[y] && y > mini_y[x] && y < maxi_y[x])\n                covered_buildings++;\n        }\n\n    return covered_buildings;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"count-covered-buildings","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1309}
